home.title: Free the Tools – everyday tools that never leave your device
home.description: Open-source tools that run in your browser. Compress PDFs and more without uploading a thing. No accounts, no ads. A Sapience Design initiative.

home.findLabel: What do you need to do?

home.empty: Try simpler words, like “smaller”, “combine” or “photo”. Or {ask}, or {sponsor} so it is built sooner.
home.aiText: Claude, Cursor and other assistants can run these tools on your own computer, free and with no login, so your files are never uploaded. It is on npm and in the official MCP Registry.
home.why3: They shouldn't put your files at risk.
home.why4: They shouldn't be hard to find.
home.whyEnd: So here they are: one place, every tool, {mark}
